metadata.question: Did nighttime lights in Obolon, Ukraine, decrease in May 2022 compared to March 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) monthly composites - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" - Compare March 2022 vs May 2022 - Location: Obolon, Ukraine (district in Kyiv) - approximately 50.51°N, 30.50°E 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS nighttime lights data doesn't need cloud masking - Use the 'avg_rad' band (average radiance) - Filter for cf_cvg (cloud-free coverage) if needed 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Nighttime lights can legitimately be 0 (power outage, conflict zone) - Compare mean radiance between March and May 2022 - If May < March, answer is A (Yes, decreased) - If May >= March, answer is B (No, did not decrease) - Handle C1/C2/C3 cases as specified ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Obolon, Ukraine (Kyiv district) const obolon = ee.Geometry.Point([30.50, 50.51]).buffer(3000); // 3km radius // 2. Load VIIRS Nighttime Lights monthly composites const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .select('avg_rad'); // 3. Get March 2022 data const march2022 = viirs .filterDate('2022-03-01', '2022-03-31') .filterBounds(obolon); const marchSize = march2022.size().getInfo(); console.log('March 2022 images:', marchSize); if (marchSize === 0) { console.log('No data for March 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get May 2022 data const may2022 = viirs .filterDate('2022-05-01', '2022-05-31') .filterBounds(obolon); const maySize = may2022.size().getInfo(); console.log('May 2022 images:', maySize); if (maySize === 0) { console.log('No data for May 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean nighttime lights for both periods const marchImg = march2022.mean(); const mayImg = may2022.mean(); // 6. Check pixel counts const marchCount = marchImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('March valid pixels:', marchCount); if (marchCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in March 2022.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const mayCount = mayImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('May valid pixels:', mayCount); if (mayCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in May 2022.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Calculate mean radiance values const marchRadiance = marchImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const mayRadiance = mayImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('March 2022 mean radiance:', marchRadiance); console.log('May 2022 mean radiance:', mayRadiance); // 8. Validation and final answer if (marchRadiance === null || mayRadiance === null || isNaN(marchRadiance) || isNaN(mayRadiance) || marchRadiance < 0 || mayRadiance < 0) { console.log('Invalid radiance values calculated.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log('Change:', ((mayRadiance - marchRadiance) / marchRadiance * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'); if (mayRadiance < marchRadiance) { console.log('Nighttime lights decreased from March to May 2022.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Nighttime lights did not decrease from March to May 2022.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
